status: Concept and interface design; not manufacturing release
assumptions: Only developed, fixed, washed and completely dried film; no interleaving paper, sleeves, staples or adhesive labels in the transport path.
80 x 300 mm and 50 sheets are user requirements. Thickness, density, forces, friction, motion and envelope are proposed design inputs, not measurements.
Each batch uses one qualified film construction/thickness class. Mixed thickness is not released by this design.
Gravity aligns/advances sheets; support toes hold remaining stack. No uncontrolled free fall or fixed thickness slot as the primary separation mechanism.
Existing ZL80 interface coordinates are nominal discussion values, not verified against a complete latest CAD assembly.
Front toe release / first-sheet peel interface is a critical unverified mechanism requiring a transparent mockup and real-film DOE.
No purchased motor, ionizer, double-sheet sensor or connector footprint is frozen.
